host.label: Computer
host.description: Filled in automatically by the installer. One or more address:port entries, comma-separated; the bar uses the first that answers.

token.label: Token
token.description: Filled in automatically by the installer and must match the computer's.

context_bar.label: Context bar
context_bar.description: A thin line along the bottom that shows how full the session's context window is.

mac.label: Install on Mac
mac.description: Connect the bar by USB, then paste into Terminal.

windows.label: Install on Windows
windows.description: Connect the bar by USB, then paste into PowerShell.
